objective.title: Objective
objective.body: Build an army of roughly 60 Riders 🐎 and defeat the Dragon 🐉 for an instant victory — or take 3 prisoners of war 🌟 (capture players who can't pay your toll) to claim the throne instead!

turnOrder.title: Turn order
turnOrder.step1: Roll the dice 🎲 (or shake your phone 📳) and move your hero around the board
turnOrder.step2: Take action based on the tile you land on
turnOrder.step3: Upgrade or sell your tiles if needed
turnOrder.step5: Every player gets a Yearly Bonus when the shared calendar year ends — or land exactly on 🏰 King's Castle for the same reward as King's Grace, right away

goldUnits.title: Resources 🟡🫓⚔️ and units 🧍
goldUnits.item1: Gold 🟡 buys tiles and upgrades. Food 🫓 and arms ⚔️ are what an army is made of: at the King's Castle a 🧍 costs {militiaCost}, a 🐎 {riderCost}.
goldUnits.item2: Owned tiles pay at the start of each of your turns: Traders 🟡, Fields and Farms 🫓, Camps and Mills ⚔️, Towers 🧍. Everyone also collects a Yearly Bonus when the calendar year ends — land exactly on the King's Castle for the same reward as King's Grace, right away.
goldUnits.itemHarvest: Every year ends with a 🌾 Harvest, a turn of its own when nobody moves: see the year's income, buy or sell 🫓 at {buyFood}/{sellFood}🟡 and ⚔️ at {buyArms}/{sellArms}🟡 (buy/sell), or exchange them 2:1.
goldUnits.item3: Fame 🏆 limits your army. 🧍 militia: {militiaCaps}. 🐎 riders (Knights only): {riderCaps}
goldUnits.item4: Once fame reaches {knightFame}🏆, the hero becomes a Knight and can hire pricier but more powerful Rider units 🐎 at the King's Castle.
goldUnits.item5: 🧍 can be sold to buy 🐎 instead (or just for the gold) — press ✖️ next to your 🧍 while at the King's Castle.
goldUnits.item6: You can hire units at the King's Castle, and also at the Tavern🧍/Stables🐎 or Worker's Caravan (paying double gold)

fame.title: Fame 🏆
fame.item1: It's your reputation. It depends on each battle won or lost and tiles owned.
fame.item2: Fame {knightFame} or more makes you eligible for promotion — the King knights you (unlocking Rider recruiting) next time you cross his Castle. It also makes you more visible for a dragon - beware, it could attack!
fame.item3: Knights are eligible to hire riders 🐎, more powerful and better suited to fight dragons or zombies
fame.item4: Higher fame lets your army grow bigger and allows to own better tiles

tiles.title: Tiles 🧩
tiles.discoverBody: new tiles and get rewarded for that
tiles.own: Own tiles by spending gold 🟡 and 🧍 units. Visiting own tiles brings you {visitGoldMult}x its own income, or {visitUnitsShare}x🧍🏻 from a Tower
tiles.landingOnOpponent: Landing on an opponent's tile — its fee 💰 is collected automatically. Once it is paid, you may leave peacefully or fight ⚔️ for revenge. A razed 🔥 tile loses all upgrades, becomes unowned, and cannot be claimed until the next round. If you cannot cover a fee, sell tiles; if that is still not enough, you become a prisoner of war, skip a turn in prison, then receive the King's ransom to continue.
tiles.syndicates: Syndicates — own every tile of some group and you form a syndicate: income bonus and fee is doubled
tiles.sellAnytime: Sell — tiles can be sold at any time for the full price of the tile and its upgrades. Click the tile's heading to reveal the Sell/Yield buttons.
tiles.yieldToKing: Yield to the King — yield a tile ('half-sold'): receive half its price immediately, but it produces no income and can't be fought over. Take it back for 60% of the tile's price. Selling a yielded tile refunds 10% less than its remaining value.
tiles.clickToView: Click on the tile's title or data to view its bonuses and defences on each level

tileUpgrades.title: Tile upgrades ⬆️
tileUpgrades.item1: Upgrade tiles paying 🟡 to increase tile's income and defence. Click the ⬆️ button to upgrade, click the title to display possible upgrades.
tileUpgrades.item2: A garrison slot holds up to {slotCapacity} defenders. Tile capacity is {level1Capacity}/{level2Capacity}/{level3Capacity} defenders at levels 1/2/3; Towers also improve their defenders' rolls.
tileUpgrades.item3: Upgrades can't be sold separately or dismantled, but their price is added to the tile's price value.
tileUpgrades.item4: You can send units to garrison a tile at any time, but can only take them back into your army while visiting that tile.
tileUpgrades.item5: Upgraded tiles allow bigger garrisons and help them soak damage: a garrison absorbs part of every hit, and the tile's level adds to that — 🏯 +{level1Pct}%, 🏯🏯 +{level2Pct}%, 🏯🏯🏯 +{level3Pct}% absorbed. Camps and Towers absorb a further {fortifiedPct}%.

specialTiles.title: Special tiles 🃏
specialTiles.kingsCastle: 🏰 King's Castle — visit to recruit 🧍 units for gold, the amount is limited by your fame. Landing exactly here also grants King's Grace — the same reward everyone else gets as a Yearly Bonus at the calendar year's end, just early and only for you.
specialTiles.sphynx:
🦁 Sphynx:
Roll dice 🎲:
1,2 - lose half of your 🟡
3,4 - lose 1/3 🧍
5 - nothing, exhale 🌬️
6 - gain half of your 🟡
specialTiles.prison: ⛓️ Prison — skip a turn. While you're in prison, noone pays for visiting your tiles
specialTiles.joker: 🃏 Joker — triggers a random global event, see below for the full list.
specialTiles.ruins: 🏚️ Ruins — landing here always triggers a fight against monster occupants, see below for details.
specialTiles.portal: 🌀 Portal — teleports you to a random other tile, which then resolves as your landing tile.
specialTiles.stables: 🐴 Stables — receive 3–12 free riders 🐎 (knights only; non-knights get gold instead)

joker.title: Joker 🃏
joker.intro: Landing on the Joker tile triggers one random event, affecting everyone (or, in some cases, just one player):
joker.taxes: 🧾 Taxes — all players lose half of their gold.
joker.plague: 🦠 Plague — all players lose half of their units.
joker.hurricane: 🌪️ Hurricane — strikes the richest player's most expensive tile, razing it, but only if they're at least 1.5x wealthier than whoever ranks second.
joker.blessing: ✨ Blessing — all owned tiles are upgraded one level.
joker.queensGift: 💍 Queen's Gift — the player who rolled it gets a free Camp/Tower tile, or 300🟡 and 5🧍 if none are free.
joker.earthquake: 🪨 Earthquake — upgraded tiles lose a level; players with no upgraded tiles lose their cheapest tile instead.
joker.meteor: ☄️ Meteor — strikes a random tile owned by the richest player, razing it.
joker.kingsGift: 👑 King's Gift — the player who rolled it receives a random artifact nobody owns yet, or 200🟡 if none are left.
joker.rust: 🟫 Rust — every player's Riders 🐎 rust away and become Militia 🧍.

travel.title: Travel 🧭
travel.fork: Fork in the road — when standing on the fork, choose the short or long route before rolling. If you can reach it during a roll, the route is chosen at random.
travel.portal: A Portal can send you directly to any other tile, including the King's Castle; that tile's normal effect then applies.

overviewControls.title: Overview controls 🔍
overviewControls.kingdom: 🏰 Kingdom Overview — tap your own Fame or Gold in the stats panel to display all players with their power rank ⭐ and total wealth 🧮.
overviewControls.garrison: ⚔️ Garrison Overview — tap your army to display all your tiles and distribute army to garrisons. Remember you couldn't take them back from the tile until you visit it!
overviewControls.player: 👤 Player Overview — tap the player icon on the map to quickly observe his possessions.

contracts.title: King's contracts 📜
contracts.item1: A Castle visit may offer a contract: claim a specified unowned tile for a gold reward. Claim it yourself to collect the reward; if someone else claims it first, the contract ends.

caravan.title: Caravan 🐪
caravan.item1: After rolling, before movement, you may encounter a caravan carrying gold, slaves, or—for a Knight—horses.
caravan.item2: Defeat the caravan guards to free the slaves (they join your army) or pillage the treasures!

dangers.title: Road and realm dangers ⚠️
dangers.ambush: Ambush — after your first lap, a famous, strong traveller can be attacked on the road. The ambush must be fought.
dangers.rogue: Rogue raid — after your first lap, a roaming horde may attack one of your non-yielded tiles. An empty garrison is razed immediately; otherwise its garrison defends.
dangers.zombies: Abandoned tiles — razed tiles are zombie-guarded, cannot be claimed until the next round, and their wild garrison grows while unclaimed. Landing on one can trigger a zombie ambush.

ruins.title: Ancient Ruins 🏚️
ruins.item1: Landing on the Ruins tile always triggers a fight against its monster occupants — there's no way to decline.
ruins.item2: The monster force is sized at 90%-105% of your own army, so it's always a close, unpredictable fight.
ruins.item3: Units lost in the battle are gone either way, win, tie, or defeat.
ruins.item4: A win or a tie has an 80% chance of turning up an unowned artifact among the rubble, on top of the usual battle outcome.

battle.title: Battle ⚔️
battle.occurs: Battles occur when a player claims a tile, or during some random encounters (caravans, ambushes, etc).
battle.statsIntro: Use your units to wipe out enemies. Each unit has its strength (HP🩸), damage range 🗡️ and energy 💪:
battle.absorption: Damage 🎲 is absorbed by defence (also 🎲). Defence usually absorbs {min}-{max}% of the damage, rare lucky ones can reach 100%, unlucky ones 0%.
battle.modifiers: Attack can also be altered by artifacts 🪓, defence — by tile upgrades 🏯
battle.energy: Energy is consumed by each attack. A completely tired unit's attack is weak (only {pct}%!), but it recovers fully if it doesn't move or attack for a turn. Swapping it out for a fresh reserve is a good strategy.
battle.unitsEquivalence: Units like 👹🥷 are equal to 🧍, and mounted 🦬🐫 to 🐎
battle.reinforcements: Each side opens with {startUnits} units at its own edge. The rest wait in reserve and march in at that edge whenever a cell there is free.
battle.controls: Every battle starts automatic. The ⚔️ button switches your side between automatic and manual control, from its next move. In manual mode there are also Undo ⬅️ and Finish turn 🚩 buttons.
battle.fromBehind: A hit from behind (from the side of the target's own starting edge) is twice as likely to be critical.
battle.escape: The player who started the fight can 🏃 escape (tap twice): it counts as a defeat and every unit on the field is lost, but the reserves are saved.
battle.heroHour: Hero's Hour is a friendly brawl between two heroes and doesn't result in heavy casualties

tactics.name: Tactics
tactics.desc: Move your own units to adjacent empty cells, swap with an adjacent unit, or target a nearby enemy for attack

attackDefend.name: Attack
attackDefend.desc: Every engaged unit with a target attacks it

impact.name: Impact
impact.desc: Marks who's under attack this round, before the result is known (a critical hit flashes ❣️ instead)

outcome.name: Outcome
outcome.desc: Each unit's own result flashes: wounded, blocked, or killed

autoToggle.name: Auto / manual
autoToggle.desc: Switches your side between automatic and manual control, from its next move

undo.name: Undo
undo.desc: Reverts your most recent placement or swap

finishTurn.name: Finish turn
finishTurn.desc: Commits this round's moves and resolves combat

escape.name: Escape
escape.desc: Ends the battle as a defeat: units on the field are lost, reserves are saved

result.name: Result
result.desc: The battle ends: victory, defeat, or a tie

battle.banzai: A 🩸 Banzai! button instead of the normal attack means the game expects you to lose that battle — you can still attack as a gamble

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.intro: Found inside Treasure Chests 🪎 — each artifact grants its owner a permanent bonus for the rest of the game.

dragon.title: Dragon 🐉
dragon.item1: With an army of roughly 60 Riders 🐎 (120 army power) at the start of your turn, choose to challenge the Dragon or roll the dice instead.
dragon.item2: Sometimes while travelling you may see the dragon in the sky. And if you're rich and famous, beware: he could attack you and burn your tiles to the ground!

saveSlots.invalidBackup: That file doesn't look like a Lake Heroes save backup.
